about_the_game:
Artisan Acre invites you to master the craft of artisanal food production through intricate processes in your rustic workshop, complete with cellars and boutique shop. You'll orchestrate the mixes of tools, time, temperature, molds, and bacteria, to transform simple ingredients into extraordinary delicacies.

Cheeses, Wines, Delicacies

This game immerses you in the world of artisanal food production, offering hands-on experience in crafting delicacies and managing your own food workshop. The game focuses on western cuisine: cheeses, wine, and charcuteries. But beyond that, Asian cuisine and cuisine from several cultures are planned too!

Beneficial Molds and Bacteria

Used in food production, molds and bacteria are crucial in Artisan Acre. Drop a thing, it contracts a mold; You might have to discard it. Or, if handled carefully, the contamination could be the start of your whole legacy, through careful preservation and strategy.

Temperature is Key

Fermentation and cooking depend on precise temperature control. Whether on the stove, in the cellar, in the workshop, or exposed to cold wind, you must manipulate temperature for successful production. Extreme temperature can destroy your ingredients—whether this helps or hinders depends entirely on your intended outcome!

Workshop and its Expansion

You will start with a workshop, with cellars and shop, where you can personalize its interior as much as you want, and expand them when you are ready to, with new equipment, new furniture, and new room.

short_description: Master cheeses, wines, and various delicacies in your own culinary atelier. Craft refined artisanal food products through careful manipulation of temperature and fermentation from living cultures. Expand your operations as you progress through an immersive culinary adventure.
